tools.name: search_clinical_trials
tools.description: Search ClinicalTrials.gov by condition, intervention, sponsor, phase, recruitment status, location, institution, study type or dates. Returns structured studies with source links and retrieval time.

tools.name: get_clinical_trial
tools.description: One study by NCT id: full structured record (status, dates, enrollment, eligibility text, sites and contacts, outcomes, documents), plus the changes AgentStructure has observed and data freshness.

tools.name: get_trial_changes
tools.description: The change history AgentStructure recorded for a study: previous and new values, event type, dates and provenance. Starts monitoring the study if it was unknown.

tools.name: compare_clinical_trials
tools.description: Side-by-side registry attributes for 2 to 5 studies. A structural comparison only, never an efficacy or safety ranking.

tools.name: search_eu_trials
tools.description: Search the EU Clinical Trials Information System (CTIS, euclinicaltrials.eu) by condition, medicine, sponsor or text, or get one trial by EU CT number (with its ClinicalTrials.gov link when listed). Experimental source.

tools.name: search_fda_updates
tools.description: Search openFDA: Drugs@FDA approvals (drug/drugsfda), recalls (drug/enforcement) or labeling (drug/label) by drug, firm, application number or date.

tools.name: get_trial_intelligence_brief
tools.description: A source-linked brief on a study, sponsor, condition, intervention, or one of your watchlists: current facts, observed developments, unknowns, and freshness.
